title: an ordinary kernel stamped with a schema_version beyond what the loader supports is rejected
why: `schema_version` is a hard gate, not a discriminant: a higher version means
this build cannot safely interpret the artifact at all, so both languages
reject it and name the version-upgrade rule regardless of pattern.
The loader's maximum supported schema_version is 2, so this fixture is
stamped 3 — one past the maximum — to pin that the rejection fires at
exactly one past what this build accepts, not at some arbitrary later value.
